verdict.rationale: Google's Batch API docs say the Gemini Batch API processes large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% of the standard cost, and the pricing page repeats the 50% saving, so the discount is documented. Webhook docs confirm that batch jobs are asynchronous long-running operations with completion notifications. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the discount, and documentation of job submission formats, turnaround time and batch limits in the evidence.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: The Gemini Batch API is designed to process large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% of the standard cost.
Webhooks are available for operations like [Batch] jobs
